integrationCompliance.title: Integration compliance

empty.title: No known compliance issues right now

evidence.redactedNote: Evidence is redacted: only key paths, type names, code values and header names are stored; no body values or customer data.

impact.tenantsNote: Tenant IDs are not shown on this screen; the record keeps at most 100 tenants.

detail.recommendationNone: No recommendation recorded for this finding.

decision.description: Your decision is written to the audit log.

hints.accept: A real change; a fix will be planned.
hints.wontfix: Real but will not be fixed; the finding closes.
hints.false_positive: Not a real change; the finding closes.

decision.fixRefHint: The commit or PR that contains the fix.

confirm.title: Mark the finding as “{action}”?

integrationWebhook.title: Instant order notification (webhook)
integrationWebhook.subtitle: Trendyol notifies this address when an order status changes; order sync starts without waiting for the scheduled pull.
integrationWebhook.onceNote: For security, the address is shown only once when it is created and is not stored on this page. Generate a new one if you lose it.
integrationWebhook.confirmCreateText: You need to enter the new address in the webhook setting of the Trendyol seller panel. The address is shown only once.
integrationWebhook.confirmRenewText: The current address stops working; you need to enter the new address in the Trendyol panel. Until then no instant notifications arrive; orders keep coming through the scheduled pull.
integrationWebhook.issuedHint: Copy this address and paste it into the webhook setting of the Trendyol seller panel.
integrationWebhook.issuedNote: This address will not be shown again. It is removed from the screen when you leave the page or press Hide.
integrationWebhook.issuedToast: Webhook address created — update it in the Trendyol panel.
integrationWebhook.copyFailed: Could not copy — the address is selected, you can copy it manually.
integrationWebhook.forbidden: Only the store owner or an administrator can create the webhook address.
integrationWebhook.error: Could not create the webhook address — make sure your Trendyol integration is set up and try again.

reauth.title: Confirm it's you

reauth.hint: If you cancel, nothing is changed.

roleHints.admin: Manages everything, including the team, store settings and integrations.
roleHints.operator: Runs day-to-day work such as orders, products, returns and messages; can't manage the team or settings.

invite.title: Invite someone to the team
invite.description: The invitation link is e-mailed and valid for 7 days. The person sets their own password; you never see or set it.
invite.emailHint: The link is sent to this address.
invite.roleCeiling: Invitations can grant only admin or operator; store ownership is transferred separately.
invite.mailFailed: The invitation was created but the e-mail couldn't be sent. Resend it from pending invitations.

errors.emailInvalid: Enter a valid e-mail address (e.g. name{'@'}company.com).
errors.forbidden: You can't grant this role. Invitations can't grant a role above your own.

invitations.title: Pending invitations
invitations.subtitle: They count towards your plan's user limit until accepted.
invitations.revokeText: The link sent to {email} will stop working. You can invite them again later.
invitations.notPending: This invitation is no longer pending; it may have been accepted or revoked. The list was refreshed.

suspend.title: Suspend {name}?
suspend.text: Their open sessions end immediately and they can't sign in until reactivated. Their account, data and history are kept.
suspend.reasonHint: Shown in the audit log; not sent to the person.
suspend.forbidden: You can't suspend this person. You can't suspend yourself, and only an owner can act on an owner.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {name}?
reactivate.text: They can sign in again with their current role.

transfer.title: Transfer store ownership
transfer.description: Ownership is transferred in two steps. You start it; the new owner accepts from the link in their e-mail while signed in to their own account.
transfer.step1Text: Choose the new owner. You may be asked for your password.
transfer.step2Text: The link is valid for 72 hours. Until it's accepted you remain the owner and can cancel.
transfer.targetHint: Only active members with a verified e-mail can be chosen.
transfer.noTargets: No active member to transfer to. Invite an admin first.
transfer.consequence: When accepted, your role becomes Admin and both of you are signed out.
transfer.started: Transfer started. {name} can accept from the link in their e-mail.
transfer.pendingText: You remain the owner until {name} accepts.
transfer.cancelText: The link sent will stop working. You can start a new transfer later.
transfer.noPending: There is no pending transfer to cancel.

gates.self: Not available for your own account
gates.ownerOnly: Only the store owner can do this
gates.lastOwner: The store's last owner can't be suspended
gates.platformAdmin: Can't transfer to a platform admin

invitation.heading: {store} invited you to join their team
invitation.summary: Create your account to join the store with the role below.
invitation.name: First name
invitation.passwordHint: At least 10 characters mixing three of upper case, lower case, digits and symbols, or a 16+ character passphrase. Don't include your name or e-mail.
invitation.successText: You accepted the invitation. For your security you aren't signed in automatically; sign in with your e-mail and new password.
invitation.noTokenText: This page only opens from the link in the invitation e-mail. Open the link again; if you refreshed, it was removed from the address for security.

errors.passwordShort: The password must be at least 10 characters.

invitation.expiredText: Invitation links are valid for 7 days. Ask the store admin to resend it; the new link will arrive by e-mail.
invitation.revokedText: The store admin withdrew this invitation. Contact them if you think this is a mistake.
invitation.acceptedText: An account was already created with this invitation. Sign in with your e-mail and password; use "Forgot password" if needed.
invitation.invalidText: The link may be incomplete or copied incorrectly. Open the link in the invitation e-mail again.

ownership.heading: Accept store ownership
ownership.text: The store owner wants to transfer the store to you. Once you accept, all rights including subscription, billing and team move to you; the previous owner becomes an Admin.
ownership.consequence: After accepting, both of you are signed out for security and must sign in again.
ownership.loginText: Sign in with the account the transfer was sent to.
ownership.successTitle: You are now the store owner
ownership.successText: You were signed out for security. Sign in again to continue.
ownership.noTokenText: This page only opens from the transfer link in the e-mail. Open the link again.
ownership.invalidText: The link may have expired, been cancelled, used, or belong to another account. Ask the owner to start the transfer again.

loginNotice.invitationAccepted: Your account was created. Sign in with your e-mail and new password.
loginNotice.ownershipTransferred: Ownership transfer completed. Please sign in again.
